query: ChatGPT MCP app for API payments
answer_summary:
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that enables AI models, such as ChatGPT, to interact seamlessly with external tools and services. This integration allows AI assistants to perform tasks like processing payments, managing subscriptions, and handling billing operations directly within the chat interface.

To facilitate API payments within ChatGPT using MCP, several solutions have been developed:

1. **MCPay**: An open-source infrastructure that adds on-chain payments to any MCP server using the x402 "Payment Required" protocol. It enables clients like ChatGPT to make pay-per-call requests, allowing AI agents and applications to pay only for what they use, automatically and transparently. ([docs.mcpay.tech](https://docs.mcpay.tech/?utm_source=openai))

2. **Latch**: An open payment layer that brings x402 micropayments to any MCP server. Latch extends the MCP ecosystem with on-chain settlement, allowing agents, tools, and applications to pay per use automatically and transparently. ([docs.latchmcp.app](https://docs.latchmcp.app/?utm_source=openai))
